title: Owner: use the quick commands on the Mac and the iPhone
goal: The owner taps each quick command in both views and sees the other project's card or page
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update, in the simple view and the full dashboard on the Mac and the iPhone app, tap Show batteries, Show trip and Grover status; each shows that project's card or page, and the disabled ones say why
privacy: Neutral invented commands, servers and results only; no tokens in configuration examples, tests or logs.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-131 Verification
escalation: The owner decides which commands stay in the list; the agent records the result

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a few taps in two views on two devices. Not a measurement.
